acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Built-in routes and valid/invalid local overrides exist.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Preview, save, dispatch and continue an existing run after changing settings.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Preview equals dispatch; invalid settings cannot replace a revision; existing runs retain model/effort; unavailable runtime blocks without fallback.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Tasks are unapproved, denied, approved or changed after review.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Review concrete contracts and approve/deny or edit a draft.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Approval starts nothing; stale/denied review blocks; only the exact approved revision is eligible.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Eligible, dependency-blocked and runtime-failing tasks exist.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Dispatch twice and retry blocked/failing requests.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: One eligible run with assigned route; durable blocked/failed reasons; no UI execution bypass.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Runs are active, interrupted, terminal or missing reliable identity.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Interrupt, inject terminal-persistence failure, restart and resume twice.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: One terminal result; original assignment/run/thread identity; no replay; unsupported/ambiguous recovery blocks.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: roadmap_recovery, recovery_commands, routing and compatibility tests.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Verification is successful, failed, absent or malformed.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Complete a runtime turn and inspect/paginate evidence.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Only independently verified success completes a task; bounded, run-isolated evidence exposes missing/failed checks.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Synthetic records contain sensitive markers and an existing destination.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Export an allowlisted local summary and inspect release contents.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: No raw prompts/events, authentication data or personal paths; overwrite needs confirmation; nothing is sent externally.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Runtime/config/storage are unavailable, incompatible or inaccessible.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Read local state, validate manifests and run readiness/boundary checks.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Actionable errors without accidental writes, implicit installation, dispatch, new listeners or wider path permissions.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: control_center, roadmap_planning, diagnostics, packaging checklist and boundary audit.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Disposable stores contain concurrent writes, corruption and incompatible schemas.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Back up, preview/confirm restore and inject replacement failure.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Consistent backup; invalid/busy restore writes nothing; rollback preserves prior state; restore never executes tasks.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: All milestone features and integration checks have evidence.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Run integrated/native acceptance and prepare final release handoff.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Actual native actions/runtime provenance recorded; findings block readiness; publication remains a separate explicit gate.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: Workspace tests/builds, native smoke, audit and release handoff.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Windows/macOS/Linux targets and disposable install environments are reviewed.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Build native installers, install/launch/upgrade/uninstall and complete first-run onboarding.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Per-platform package/checksum and observed lifecycle/onboarding evidence; state preserved; missing target/prerequisite blocks v0.7.0.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: Platform matrix, installer build/smoke artifacts, onboarding tests/native evidence.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: A local versioned spec and draft task graph are available.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Edit/review/save/reopen the spec, link acceptance and round-trip graph changes.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Versioned scenarios/decisions trace to tasks/checks; invalid/uncovered drafts block; no execution or history rewrite.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Supported native Desktop, disposable cwd surfaces and explicit hook action approval exist.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Install global integration, submit/replay messages, test failure/recursion and uninstall.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: One ingress and one explicit approved coordinator execution; other configuration preserved; unsupported/absent runtime blocks.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: global_desktop tests plus actual native Desktop route/run/thread/turn evidence.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Two disposable registered projects and persistent queues exist.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Switch projects, enqueue/reorder/pause, schedule competing scopes and reconnect to a long run.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Project isolation, durable queues, eligibility and shared-write exclusion; bounded ordered events; no duplicate run or silent replay.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: multi_project, task_queues, long_running and UI evidence.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Synthetic adversarial paths, runtime versions and upgrade fixtures exist.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Probe permissions/data boundaries and upgrade/rollback supported combinations.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Unauthorized access rejected; safe local-only exports; identities/history preserved; incompatibility and unresolved security findings block.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Integrated/native gates pass and beta publication/observation has separate authorization.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Prepare beta, assess actual feedback/blockers, validate stable promotion and handoff.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Traceable beta results and resolved blockers required for v1.0.0 readiness; target, readiness and actual publication never conflated.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: beta-evidence, stable-readiness, release-handoff and regression results.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: An approved task/session and pending runtime approval request exist.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Send/continue interactive input, stream events and answer the exact pending request.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Coordinator owns stdio turns/permissions; input and approval replay cannot duplicate turns; native execution and verification receipts remain separate.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: Core/native interactive_execution tests and installed-native interactive evidence.
